sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Running the sync and printing results
sections.what: Runs the sync once, prints the counts, then prints one line per applicable signal showing its status, project name, updates written, linked project ids and reason.
sections.why: Lets the owner see outcomes without opening the database.
sections.watch_out: The force flag can repeat writes that were already made, so check before using it.

summary: Runs the Opportunity Map to Yard sync once and prints the result for each signal.
purpose: Lets the owner trigger the sync by hand and see what happened to each signal.
why: Likely reason: a manual trigger for checking or forcing the sync outside the app.
how: Runs the sync for all signals, forced if the flag is given, and prints the counts as JSON. Then reads each applicable signal and prints its status, project name, updates written, linked project ids and reason, one line each, and exits.
inputs: An optional force flag, the database connection and the stored sync results.
outputs: Printed counts and one line per signal.
risks: The force flag can rewrite data already synced. The script exits right after printing, so it does not clean up.
debug: Check the reason shown for each signal. If the counts are zero, no signal was applicable.
